mapper.select: SELECT i.strategy_id, s.instance_id FROM quant_strategy_position_state s JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id JOIN quant_strategy_symbol b ON b.id=i.strategy_symbol_id JOIN quant_symbol q ON q.id=b.symbol_id WHERE i.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND s.position_id=#{positionId} AND s.position_cycle_key=#{cycleKey} AND q.symbol=#{symbol} AND s.direction=#{direction}
